senses.gloss:
वैगुण्य वैगुण्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-गुण), ab-
sence of or freedom from qualities, absence of attri-
butes; difference of qualities or properties, contra-
riety of properties, diversity, contrariety; inferiority,
baseness, badness, vileness; unskilfulness, awkward-
ness, clumsiness, waywardness; fault, defect.

वैग्रहिक वैग्रहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-ग्रह),
corporeal, bodily.
